design.assertion: ONE binary PASS: movedC(stone) > movedB(wood) > movedA(bare) over 0.4s window
design.branches_used: OLD fallback branch (UsePathfinding=false default in isolated V-test scenes, same as V59)
three_lanes: Pawn A: bare ground (y=-24), no floor entity, bonus=1.0x
Pawn B: FloorEntity (y=-26), BoxCollider2D isTrigger 30x1, MoveBonus=1.30x
Pawn C: StoneFloorEntity IS-A FloorEntity (y=-28), BoxCollider2D isTrigger 30x1, MoveBonus=1.50x
design.rationale_floor_width: V59 lesson: pawn crosses 1x1 cell in <0.1s at speed 4.6 — spans full travel to keep pawn on bonus for the whole window
design.sanity_check: FloorEntity.BonusAt() read at startX+1 on each lane's y after one physics frame, reported in assert message

read_only_accessors_used: FloorEntity.BonusAt(Vector2 pos) (public static float) -> live per-cell measurement
flags_for_qa: StoneFloorEntity.stoneMoveBonus is [SerializeField] private — MoveBonus public override is sufficient; no gap blocks this test.

Physics2D.OverlapBoxAll (used by BonusAt) requires that BoxCollider2D.isTrigger=true colliders are registered before the measurement window; test yields one physics frame after spawning floors before the timed window.
Lane y-separation of 2 units is > 6x the BonusAt OverlapBox radius (0.3f) so adjacent-lane cross-contamination cannot occur.
UsePathfinding is false by default (same as V59 and all prior isolated V-tests); test does NOT touch PawnMovement.UsePathfinding.
wiki_acceptance: Dim3 terrain-move-cost row + Dim5 V59b: a gated test asserts stone-floor effective move speed (1.50x) > wood-floor (1.30x) > bare ground as ONE PASS line.
